name: Arencia Fresh Green Rice Mochi Cleanser  | Low pH Facial Cleanser with Rice Powder & Green Tea | Hydrating Deep Cleansing | 120g
description:
Give your skin a fresh and gentle cleansing experience with the Arencia Fresh Green Rice Mochi Cleanser 120g. Formulated with rice powder, rice extract, green tea, witch hazel, centella asiatica, and sodium hyaluronate, this low-pH facial cleanser helps remove dirt, excess oil, and impurities while maintaining skin moisture. Its unique mochi-like texture, created through a traditional kneading process, produces a rich lather for a comfortable cleansing experience. The formula helps leave skin feeling clean, smooth, refreshed, and hydrated without an overly dry or stripped feeling. Suitable for daily cleansing and a variety of skin types, including sensitive skin.

How to Use
Take an appropriate amount of cleanser onto wet hands
Add a small amount of water and work into a rich lather
Gently massage the foam over the face
Pay attention to areas where dirt and excess oil tend to accumulate
Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water
Pat the face dry with a clean towel
Follow with your regular skincare routine
